item.title: Karnataka Shocker: Class 9 Student Dies of Sudden Heart Attack in Davangere
item.description: A 14-year-old Class 9 student named Muzammil died of a suspected heart attack in Davangere, Karnataka, on February 23, 2026. The teen collapsed at home and was declared dead on the way to the hospital. The tragedy has reignited concerns over sudden cardiac deaths in youth, prompting calls for better health screening for students in the state.

item.title: iQOO 15R Price in India, Specifications and Features
item.description: iQOO has launched the iQOO 15R in India, featuring the advanced Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 chipset and a massive 7,600mAh battery.
